periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with the vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior margin extending notably further from the patch center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape with a smooth posterior curve transitioning across the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thickness occupying approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the lateral interface.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral displacement with a significant inter-pinna gap relative to the cranial width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular curvature at the superior boundary of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Rare brown-and-white phenotype; high-contrast regions are dark brown rather than black, and standard white regions exhibit tan/creamy pigmentation, particularly on the posterior torso.
